why: The source-verified Pico Event core has distinct exact date records across 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2024. Assess whether historically loss-affected taxa found in Pico recur in multiple distinct field observation years rather than single survey hits.

measure.primary: Count S1 loss-affected taxa seen on Pico in 1,2,3,4 independently dated calendar years
measure.separate: Count distinct S1 taxon × Pico-year positive detections and per-year richness
measure.exposure: Only source-reported species-rank non-absent positive observations with author MDY reconstructed exactly
measure.notes: Observed repeated island occurrences may represent persistent populations, immigration, misidentified taxa or spatially different sampled plants; cannot distinguish mechanisms.
